milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the potted dead bush (located at spawn-relative 8, 1, 8 inside the spruce shelter) and face toward it, demonstrating they have found and can see the object. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to visually confirm the block (likely inside or at the doorway of the shelter), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward it.
